title: Replace the workshop label printer?
question: Which next check would make this replacement decision less uncertain?

options.name: Buy a compact thermal printer
assumptions: Thermal labels will stay readable in storage
disconfirmingEvidence: A stored sample faded near a window
One supplier lists a different core diameter
options.nextCheck: Store a printed sample in the supply cabinet for two weeks and measure the label core.

agreement: Both options need a concrete cost and compatibility check before acting.
conflict: The repair path assumes the fault has a bounded fix; the thermal path assumes its labels last long enough.
unresolvedQuestions: Will a repair quote remain below the replacement cost?
Will thermal labels remain readable in the supply cabinet?
